generated.details: A woven fiber wall piece hangs high at far left, its interlaced natural strands suspended from a wooden rod with a short fringed lower edge.
At mid-right, separate from the equipment table and cropped by the frame, the comfortable cream sofa has fabric-covered arms, plump seat and back cushions, and short supporting feet.
Beside it on a nearer-right wooden side table, the low ceramic candleholder has a shallow rounded body, recessed candle socket and flat stable foot.
